test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose "No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.**

In the summer, the bear __eaten a lot__ of berries.
solution:
The correct answer is option no. (4) i.e.** 'eats a lot'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Singular verb** is used with **singular subject.**
 
• As the given sentence has singular verb **'the bear'**
 
• **In the summer **phrase denotes that the tense of the given sentence is** present indefinite tense.**

Therefore, the correct sentence is:*** In the summer, the bear eats a lot __of berries.***

Thus,the correct answer is option no. **(4)**
